meta.source: Razorpay API Error Documentation Guide (Official) — arthraksha/data/
meta.description: Real Razorpay error taxonomy built from official docs. Each entry maps error reason → category → recovery path with actual payload structure.

payload_structure.code: Top-level error type: BAD_REQUEST_ERROR | GATEWAY_ERROR | SERVER_ERROR
payload_structure.reason: Specific machine-readable reason string (the key identifier)
payload_structure.source: Who caused it: customer | business | gateway | razorpay | issuer_bank | beneficiary_bank
payload_structure.step: Where in the flow: payment_initiation | payment_authentication | payment_authorization

customer.meaning: Customer made an error (wrong OTP, cancelled payment, insufficient funds)
customer.who_acts: Display a meaningful message and prompt them to retry

business.meaning: Merchant integration sent an invalid request (missing field, wrong amount, method not enabled)
business.who_acts: Fix the request parameters before retrying

gateway.meaning: Payment gateway or bank returned an error. Usually transient.
gateway.who_acts: Retry or ask the customer to use a different payment method

razorpay.who_acts: Retry after a short delay. Contact support if persists.

issuer_bank.meaning: Error at the card/account issuing bank
issuer_bank.who_acts: Customer retries with different method or bank fixes issue

TECHNICAL.description: Infrastructure or bank-side technical failures. Not customer's fault. High retry success rate.

UNINTENTIONAL.description: Customer intended to pay but something went wrong — insufficient funds, expired card, wrong PIN.

INTENTIONAL.description: Customer deliberately stopped payment — cancellation, dispute, fraud flag.

AMBIGUOUS.description: Cannot determine intent from error code alone. Requires LLM reasoning + history.

MERCHANT_FIX.description: Integration/config error on merchant side. Not customer-recoverable. Needs merchant action.

insufficient_funds.description: The customer does not have sufficient funds in the account to complete the payment.
insufficient_funds.next_step: The customer must retry with a different card or method.
insufficient_funds.customer_message: Your account has insufficient funds. We've sent you a payment link to try a different method.
insufficient_funds.internal_note: Send payment link immediately. High recovery rate within 24h.

sample_payload.description: Your payment didn't go through as it was declined by the bank. Try another payment method or contact your bank.

card_expired.next_step: The customer must retry with a valid card.
card_expired.customer_message: Your card has expired. Please update your payment method.
card_expired.internal_note: Send update-card link. High recovery rate.

sample_payload.description: Your card has expired. Try another card.

card_number_invalid.next_step: Customer needs to enter a valid card number.
card_number_invalid.customer_message: The card details on file appear invalid. Please update your payment method.
card_number_invalid.internal_note: Old card on file. Send update-payment-method link.

sample_payload.description: The card number provided is invalid.

incorrect_cvv.description: The customer has entered an incorrect CVV to complete the payment.
incorrect_cvv.next_step: The customer must retry and enter the correct CVV.
incorrect_cvv.customer_message: Your card's CVV is incorrect. Please retry with the correct CVV.
incorrect_cvv.internal_note: Customer-side error. Prompt to retry directly.

sample_payload.description: Your payment didn't go through as the CVV entered is invalid.

incorrect_otp.description: The customer has entered an incorrect OTP to complete the payment.
incorrect_otp.next_step: The customer must retry and enter the correct OTP.
incorrect_otp.customer_message: Payment failed because the OTP was incorrect. Please retry.

sample_payload.description: Payment failed as the OTP entered is invalid.

otp_attempts_exceeded.next_step: Customer needs to wait and retry after some time.
otp_attempts_exceeded.customer_message: Too many OTP attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
otp_attempts_exceeded.internal_note: Wait 30 min then send payment link.

sample_payload.description: OTP generation/validation attempt limit exceeded.

otp_expired.next_step: Customer needs to request a new OTP.
otp_expired.customer_message: Your OTP expired. Please try your payment again.
otp_expired.internal_note: Immediate retry nudge — customer was mid-flow.

sample_payload.description: OTP has expired.

transaction_daily_limit_exceeded.description: The customer has exceeded the daily transaction limit set on the card.
transaction_daily_limit_exceeded.next_step: The customer must retry using a different instrument or wait 24 hours.
transaction_daily_limit_exceeded.customer_message: Your daily transaction limit has been reached. Try again tomorrow or use a different payment method.
transaction_daily_limit_exceeded.internal_note: Schedule retry link for next morning (8 AM).

sample_payload.description: Your payment didn't go through as the daily limit for your payment method has been exceeded.

transaction_limit_exceeded.description: The customers have exceeded the credit or debit limit set on their cards.
transaction_limit_exceeded.next_step: The customer must retry using a different bank's card or method.
transaction_limit_exceeded.customer_message: Your card limit has been reached. Please try a different payment method.
transaction_limit_exceeded.internal_note: Suggest alternate method. High recovery with UPI if card limit hit.

sample_payload.description: Your payment didn't go through as the transaction limit has been exceeded.

transaction_frequency_limit_exceeded.description: NPCI has a transaction limit both on the amount and the frequency per day.
transaction_frequency_limit_exceeded.next_step: Please retry using another payment method.
transaction_frequency_limit_exceeded.customer_message: UPI transaction frequency limit reached for today. Please use your card or netbanking.

sample_payload.description: Your payment failed as NPCI transaction limit has been exceeded.

invalid_vpa.description: The customer has entered an incorrect VPA to complete the payment.
invalid_vpa.next_step: The customer must check and enter the correct VPA.
invalid_vpa.customer_message: Your UPI ID appears to be invalid or deregistered. Please update your payment method.
invalid_vpa.internal_note: Customer may have switched UPI app. Get fresh VPA.

sample_payload.description: The VPA provided is not valid.

transaction_on_vpa_restricted.description: Transaction on this VPA has been temporarily/permanently blocked by the PSP.
transaction_on_vpa_restricted.next_step: The customer to retry with another UPI ID.
transaction_on_vpa_restricted.customer_message: Your UPI ID has been restricted. Please try with another UPI ID or payment method.
transaction_on_vpa_restricted.internal_note: Could be temporary PSP block or permanent. Needs LLM to decide.

sample_payload.description: Transaction on this VPA has been temporarily blocked by the PSP.

authentication_failed.description: The payment failed as 3D secure, or OTP authentication failed.
authentication_failed.next_step: The customer must enter correct authentication details to complete the payment.
authentication_failed.customer_message: Payment authentication failed. Please retry and enter your OTP correctly.
authentication_failed.internal_note: 3DS failure. Send retry nudge. If repeated, send payment link.

sample_payload.description: Payment failed because authentication failed.

payment_cancelled.description: The customer has explicitly cancelled the payment due to which the authentication failed to complete.
payment_cancelled.next_step: The customer must retry to complete the payment.
payment_cancelled.customer_message: You cancelled your last payment. Was it intentional? We can help you complete it.
payment_cancelled.internal_note: Cancellation could be accidental or intentional. LLM + history to decide.

sample_payload.description: Payment processing failed because payment cancelled.

payment_timed_out.description: The customer did not complete the transaction within the specified time.
payment_timed_out.next_step: The customer must retry and complete the transaction within the time.
payment_timed_out.customer_message: Your payment session timed out. Please retry — it only takes a few seconds.
payment_timed_out.internal_note: Customer was present but slow. Immediate retry nudge works well.

sample_payload.description: Payment was not completed within the time limit.

debit_instrument_blocked.description: The customer is using a blocked card to complete the payment. The card could have been blocked by the issuer or by customers themselves.
debit_instrument_blocked.next_step: The customer must retry with a different card or method.
debit_instrument_blocked.customer_message: Your card has been blocked. Please try a different payment method.
debit_instrument_blocked.internal_note: Self-blocked = intentional signal. Bank-blocked = unintentional. LLM needed.

sample_payload.description: Your payment didn't go through as the card used is blocked.

payment_risk_check_failed.description: Payment declined due to risk checks.
payment_risk_check_failed.next_step: The customer must retry with a different card or method.
payment_risk_check_failed.customer_message: This transaction could not be processed. Please contact support.
payment_risk_check_failed.internal_note: Risk flag. Do NOT retry. Escalate to risk/fraud team.

sample_payload.description: Your payment didn't go through as it was declined by the risk team.

bank_technical_error.description: The issuing bank was facing technical problems at the moment the payment was attempted.
bank_technical_error.next_step: The customer must try using another bank account or another method.
bank_technical_error.customer_message: Your bank encountered a technical issue. We'll retry automatically.
bank_technical_error.internal_note: Bank CBS error. Auto-retry after 2h. High success rate.

sample_payload.description: Your payment didn't go through due to a technical issue at your bank.

bank_not_available.description: Bank is not available due to a downtime or a technical issue.
bank_not_available.customer_message: Your bank is temporarily unavailable. We'll retry your payment soon.
bank_not_available.internal_note: Bank downtime window. Monitor status and auto-retry.

sample_payload.description: The bank is not available. Please try again.

bank_cutoff_in_progress.description: Bank CBS cutoff is in progress.
bank_cutoff_in_progress.customer_message: Your bank's systems are under maintenance. We'll retry your payment automatically.
bank_cutoff_in_progress.internal_note: End-of-day/week bank cutoff. Retry after 3h window.

sample_payload.description: Bank CBS cutoff is in progress. Retry after some time.

gateway_technical_error.description: Technical error occurred at the gateway.
gateway_technical_error.customer_message: A temporary gateway error occurred. We'll retry automatically.
gateway_technical_error.internal_note: Transient gateway failure. Auto-retry with exponential backoff.

sample_payload.description: Payment failed due to a technical issue at the gateway.

issuer_technical_error.description: Technical error occurred at the card issuer.
issuer_technical_error.next_step: Please retry after some time or use another card.
issuer_technical_error.customer_message: Your card issuer encountered a technical issue. We'll retry shortly.

sample_payload.description: Payment failed due to a technical issue at the card issuer.

request_timed_out.customer_message: Payment timed out at the gateway. We'll retry automatically.
request_timed_out.internal_note: Network-level timeout between Razorpay and bank. Auto-retry safe.

sample_payload.description: The request to the bank timed out.

server_error.next_step: Please retry after some time or reach out to Razorpay.
server_error.customer_message: A server error occurred. Your payment was not charged. We'll retry.
server_error.internal_note: Razorpay-side issue. Monitor status page. Retry with idempotency key.

sample_payload.description: We are facing some trouble completing your request at the moment. Please try again shortly.

upi_app_technical_error.description: Technical error occurred at the customer's PSP due to which the payment failed.
upi_app_technical_error.next_step: The customer must retry the payment.
upi_app_technical_error.customer_message: Your UPI app encountered a technical issue. We'll retry automatically.

sample_payload.description: UPI payment failed due to a technical error at the customer's UPI app.

mandate_creation_failed.next_step: Customer needs to retry mandate creation or use another payment method.
mandate_creation_failed.customer_message: Setting up your payment mandate failed. We'll help you fix this.
mandate_creation_failed.internal_note: Could be bank refusal or PSP issue. LLM + history to classify.

sample_payload.description: Mandate creation failed.

mandate_creation_expired.next_step: Customer needs to retry mandate creation.
mandate_creation_expired.customer_message: Your payment mandate setup expired. Please complete setup again.
mandate_creation_expired.internal_note: Customer didn't complete in time. Send re-mandate link.

sample_payload.description: Mandate creation has expired.

payment_declined.next_step: Customer needs to retry with another payment method.
payment_declined.customer_message: Your payment was declined. Let us help you recover it.
payment_declined.internal_note: Generic decline — could be anything. LLM must classify using history + bank.

sample_payload.description: The payment has been declined.

payment_declined_due_to_high_traffic.description: Payment declined due to high traffic at the gateway.
payment_declined_due_to_high_traffic.customer_message: Payment gateway is busy. We'll retry your payment shortly.

sample_payload.description: Payment declined due to high traffic.

vpa_resolution_failed.description: The UPI network failed to validate the VPA.
vpa_resolution_failed.next_step: The customer must retry using a different bank account or method.
vpa_resolution_failed.customer_message: UPI ID validation failed temporarily. We'll retry shortly.

sample_payload.description: UPI network failed to validate VPA.

authorisation_declined_by_psp.description: PSP app has rejected the authorisation request.
authorisation_declined_by_psp.next_step: Recheck the customer's VPA and retry.
authorisation_declined_by_psp.customer_message: Your UPI app rejected the payment. Please check and try again.
authorisation_declined_by_psp.internal_note: PSP rejection — could be app issue or deliberate. LLM to classify.

sample_payload.description: PSP app rejected the authorisation.

bank_account_invalid.description: The bank account is not valid. The customer or bank could have closed the account.
bank_account_invalid.next_step: The customer must try using a valid bank account or another method.
bank_account_invalid.customer_message: Your linked bank account is no longer valid. Please update your payment method.
bank_account_invalid.internal_note: Account closed or invalid. Send update-payment-method link.

sample_payload.description: The bank account is invalid or has been closed.

payment_session_expired.next_step: Customer needs to start a new payment session.
payment_session_expired.customer_message: Your payment session expired. Please retry — it takes just a moment.
payment_session_expired.internal_note: Session timeout. Send fresh payment link immediately.

sample_payload.description: The payment session has expired.

incorrect_atm_pin.next_step: Customer needs to enter the correct ATM PIN.
incorrect_atm_pin.customer_message: Incorrect PIN was entered. Please retry with your correct PIN.
incorrect_atm_pin.internal_note: Debit card PIN failure. Immediate retry nudge.

sample_payload.description: Incorrect ATM PIN entered.

pin_attempts_exceeded.next_step: Customer needs to wait and retry after some time.
pin_attempts_exceeded.customer_message: Too many PIN attempts. Your card may be temporarily locked. Try again in a few hours.
pin_attempts_exceeded.internal_note: Card temporarily blocked after PIN failures. Follow up in 4h.

sample_payload.description: PIN attempt limit exceeded.

auto_retry.description: System automatically retries payment without customer involvement

payment_link.description: Send customer a fresh payment link via SMS/email

exit_survey_then_stop.description: Send exit survey to understand churn reason, then stop recovery

llm_classify_then_act.description: Use LLM + history to classify, then apply appropriate path

escalate_to_human.description: Flag for human review — risk, legal, or support team

alert_merchant_stop_recovery.description: Merchant integration issue — stop recovery, alert merchant

subscription.halted.description: Subscription halted after repeated charge failures
